patterns: APPSC asks first Dutch factory in Andhra/India = Machilipatnam 1605 (G2 2017; GS 2024 match Dutch 1605 vs British 1611).
Dutch HQ shift Pulicat -> Nagapattinam (1690) is an APPSC G2 2005 key; UPSC 2003 keyed Pulicat as earliest when Machilipatnam was not an option - read the options.
Other PSCs ask which Bengal factory was Dutch (Chinsurah) and lists of Dutch trading centres.
Trap: Mahe was French; Colachel 1741 (Travancore beat the Dutch) and Bedara 1759 (English beat the Dutch).
App MCQs are sound and AP-tilted; a few go into fine detail (Koringa, Chittavalasa, Linschoten) beyond PYQ depth.
